posts.content_md:
I recently [upgraded my tablet pc](http://www.dragonseye.com/blog/archives/272-Fujitsu-T4215-mini-review.html) & just [adapted my exposure logs](http://www.dragonseye.com/HoloLogs.pdf) for use on it. now to put a filter gel on the screen & see if I can use the tablet in the lab.

Wifey will roll her eyes but if I can do something on the computer, I probably will.

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Michael, we must be rowing the same boat...lol.

I just installed WiFi a few weeks ago and now can carry my laptop from the family room to the lab and still maintain connectivity to the rest of the world. I never had internet connection in the lab before. It's sweet!
